So you should be using Visual Studio. Just get the latest free version.

Open the solution and right click on the the solution in the solution explorer, select "Restore Nuget Packages", when it's done, hit Ctl+Shift+B (builds entire solution) and you should be good. If you don't see the option to restore, select or turn on the option to "Enable Nuget Package Restore on Build" or similar. They keep changing things from version to version but I guarantee that you don't have the nuget packages since that's not something you check into your repository.

After that, you'll want to check the connection strings in web.config. It's a key called "connectionstrings" so do a search for that and you should be good.

You'll want to set up a local sql server instance and change the connection string so that it matches your local installed instance.
